hookScope: Set a hook on a scope the product owns, not on :root, so a runtime change restyles that scope only. To change one variant only, set the hook on [data-variant] within the scope, for example .promo [data-variant="stacked"] { --scnx-accordion-trigger-background-hover: …; }; without it, the hook applies to every variant in the scope.
